proof_text:
have h_main : countDigits_postcond (s) (countDigits (s) h_precond) h_precond := by
    have h₁ : countDigits s h_precond = List.length (List.filter isDigit s.toList) := by rfl
    have h₂ : countDigits s h_precond - List.length (List.filter isDigit s.toList) = 0 := by
      rw [h₁]
      <;> simp [Nat.sub_self]
    have h₃ : List.length (List.filter isDigit s.toList) - countDigits s h_precond = 0 := by
      rw [h₁]
      <;> simp [Nat.sub_self]
    exact ⟨h₂, h₃⟩
  exact h_main
